_about: Research input, NOT active in the synthetic stage. All numbers transcribed from the source; formal fit errors, not full systematic uncertainties. Unknown coefficients stay null. See docs/sources/vokrouhlicky-2025-hildas.md.

source.title: Orbital and absolute magnitude distribution of Hilda population
source.citation: Vokrouhlický, D., Nesvorný, D., Brož, M., Bottke, W. F., Deienno, R., Fuls, C. D. & Shelly, F. C. (2025). AJ 169, 242; arXiv:2503.04403v1.

domain.coordinateWarning: Appendix B model proper parameters; not Appendix C numerical proper elements.
domain.unsupported: H > 17 has limited constraints; no model extension here. Existing catalogue treatment remains active for all H.

background.density: (p-c)^alpha exp(-0.5 ((p-cBar)/sigma)^beta); normalized on the published domain

aProper.unit: au for c, cBar and sigma; others dimensionless

magnitude.form: cubic splines of log10 N(<H); slopes are segment means of the cumulative distribution
magnitude.missing: Explicit spline boundary conditions / implementation not supplied in this paper.

Hilda.hcmNote: Observed membership, not the fitted bias-corrected component normalization.
Hilda.orbitalForm: Gaussian a_p and sin I_p; broad Gaussian e_p plus concentration near 0.2

Schubart.hcmNote: Observed membership, not the fitted bias-corrected component normalization.
Schubart.orbitalForm: Asymmetric a_p; two peaks in e_p; sin I_p Gaussian plus high-inclination leg

Potomac.hcmNote: Observed membership, not the fitted bias-corrected component normalization.
Potomac.orbitalForm: Gaussian a_p and sin I_p; deficient low-e_p fragments

osculatingMapping.eccentricity: e exp(i varpi) = kappa e_J exp(i varpi_J) + e_p exp(i varpi_p) (approximate B12); B11 is the alternative canonical mapping
osculatingMapping.inclination: sin I exp(i node) = kappaPrime sin I_J exp(i node_J) + sin I_p exp(i node_p) (B13)
osculatingMapping.semimajorAxisAndLongitude: Appendix B.3: uniform polar angle on the averaged Hamiltonian level curve, both longitude branches
osculatingMapping.required: Jupiter elements in the same frame at the product epoch; numerical Hamiltonian B8-B9 and canonical transform B3-B7; Appendix D frame rotation; not independent a and angle marginals
osculatingMapping.uncertainty: Median kappa replaces orbit-dependent values ~1 to 2.5; approximate timescale decoupling; not an individual osculating uncertainty budget.

catalogue.section: Appendix C numerical proper elements; publisher label file columns 34-43

uncertainty: Table 2 errors are formal; §5.4 notes model choice uncertainty requires additional variants. §5.3 notes Hilda/Potomac template undershoot and family members assigned to background.
